title: A Thursday "This week in North County" email is built from live Events

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 9 of the launch brief (ADR-1720); marketing sends it from 3 December 2026. TODAY: the only weekly email is the Sunday digest (app/api/cron/weekly-digest/route.ts, vercel.json "0 14 * * 0"), per member, showing only Events they already RSVPd to (lib/digest.ts:126-151). Nothing reads upcoming Events by place. Regions are seeded (North County, Carlsbad, Encinitas, Oceanside, Escondido: 20240107000000_seed_nexus_regions.sql). THE FIX: a Thursday cron that builds "This week in <region>" from public upcoming Events in the region and sends it to subscribers in that region through the send gate, idempotent per run (the SCAN-611 lesson). Empty regions send nothing. Wave 2 (from 1 December). CLOSED 2026-10-06: app/api/cron/this-week (vercel.json "0 16 * * 4") reads public, published, not-cancelled Events in the next 7 days, picks each launch region's (lib/this-week.ts, North County by city name), and sends "This week in <region>" (lib/email.ts sendThisWeekEmail) to members whose profile city is in the region, through resolveSendGate events. Idempotent per week by the outbox dedupe key this-week:<region>:<iso week>:<profile>. Empty regions send nothing. A dry run (counts only) until THIS_WEEK_SENDS_FROM = 2026-12-03. Cron count 33 (ARCHITECTURE, cron-freshness test), weekly SLO group, CRON_UNMONITORED (no free check). Help (notifications) and changelog updated. When LIVE-802 (#3230, also a new cron) lands first, the count becomes 34 at merge.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-806";const v=JSON.parse(r("vercel.json")||"{}");const crons=(v.crons||[]).filter(c=>/\s4$/.test(String(c.schedule).trim())||/\s(THU|thu)$/.test(String(c.schedule).trim()));const hit=crons.find(c=>{const d="app"+c.path.split("?")[0];return walk(d).concat(walk("lib")).some(f=>/This week in/.test(r(f)))});if(!hit)fail(ID+": no Thursday cron sends a This week in email")'
verify.note: Fails until vercel.json schedules a Thursday cron and the code carries the This week in email.
